1.name: Frivolous Oath
1.desc: When Remie enters the battlefield, she gains the maximum number of <color=#FFFFFF>[Pseudo Anomaly Rounds]</color> based on her own attributes. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180 seconds. When a Character triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> effect, ignore the target's 40% All-Attribute RES. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate: Entrance]</color>, gain 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger at most once every 18 seconds.

2.name: Cascading Clamor
2.desc:
The maximum number of <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly Rounds]</color> Remie can store is increased to 4, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Mutation]</color> Degree is increased to 2. When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>[Mutation]</color> reaction, up to 2 <color=#FFFFFF>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> will be consumed. When 2 <color=#FFFFFF>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> are consumed, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Mutation Coefficient]</color> of this <color=#FFFFFF>[Mutation]</color> is increased by 25%;
At the same time, the frequency at which the character auto-activates Support Skills to apply <color=#FFFFFF>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> to enemies while in <color=#FFFFFF>[Flight Stance]</color> is increased, and the number of <color=#FFFFFF>[Lumen Buildup Points]</color> applied per single skill use is also increased from 1 to 2.

4.name: The Long Goodbye
4.desc: When Remie triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> effect, DMG Multiplier is additionally increased by 20%.

5.name: The Wayfarer Drinks Deep of Oblivion

6.name: Prophetic Feathers of a Thousand Wingbeats
6.desc: When Remie uses <color=#FFFFFF>[Maximum Firepower]</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>[True: Full-Barrage Launch]</color>, she triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>[Luminize]</color> effect 2 times; if the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> lands on a target, Remie gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>[Pseudo Anomaly Rounds]</color> after the skill ends. <color=#FFFFFF>[Pseudo Anomaly Rounds]</color> obtained this way deal 20% of their original DMG; In <color=#FFFFFF>[Additional Ability]</color>, the number of <color=#FFFFFF>[Anomaly]</color> Characters required is reduced by 1.
